items.title: San Ysidro Health - El Cajon (CMSS) — Free Food
items.description: Free food at San Ysidro Health - El Cajon (CMSS) (San Ysidro Health). Schedule: Tue 10 AM–12:30 PM (CMSS parking lot; or until supplies last). Eligibility: Open to all; walk-ins accepted (serves El Cajon refugee & immigrant community). Call (619) 631-7400 to confirm before you go — hours change and supplies can run out. Source: community research, Sep 2026.
